implementation: Affine restriction of the actual ordinaryFlowFamily, following the existing c5 sector tower proof, with the actual bb419 parameterLoss selected once for k before all s. The state/sector base and radius, C, flow and stored sample remain fixed.
scope_limits: This is the first local consumer adaptation, not a complete N02/N03 port.
The shared Nonlinear definition is pinned to bb419; the generic sector provider is taken from c5. No merged overlay has been instantiated or compiled.
The old all-order uniform-loss sector theorem is neither imported nor used.
Remaining closed tower, smallness, inverse and endpoint circle consumers must explicitly preserve order-dependent losses.
